text: {"label":"Compassionate Care in Behavior Analysis","definition":"Conceptual analyses, definitions, measurement, and training of compassion and compassionate care in behavior-analytic practice. This includes therapeutic relationships with caregivers, graduate training, and organizational approaches to embedding compassion.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on compassion toward clients and caregivers as a professional repertoire, not practitioner self-care and mindfulness, general caregiver training methods, or clinical behavior analysis and psychotherapy."}
